arxiv-2012-08223.title: Long-term prediction intervals with many covariates
arxiv-2012-08223.creator: Sayar Karmakar, Marek Chudý, and Wei Biao Wu
arxiv-2012-08223.description: Abstract Accurate forecasting is one of the fundamental focuses in the literature of econometric time-series. Often practitioners and policymakers want to predict outcomes of an entire time horizon in the future instead of just a single k k -step ahead prediction. These series, apart from their own possible non-linear dependence, are often also influenced by many external predictors.

arxiv-2107-04800.title: Anisotropic Penetration Depths of Corner States in a Higher-Order Topological Insulator
arxiv-2107-04800.creator: Nobuhiro Arai 1 and Shuichi Murakami 1,2
arxiv-2107-04800.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nobuhiro Arai 1 and Shuichi Murakami 1,2. Higher-order topological insulators in two dimensions have states that localize at their corners, called corner states. In this paper, we reveral characteristics of the penetration depth of their corner states by using the Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes model.

arxiv-2112-11444.title: ESAN: Efficient Sentiment Analysis Network of A-Shares Research Reports for Stock Price Prediction
arxiv-2112-11444.creator: Tuo Sun, Wanrong Zheng, Shufan Yu, Mengxun Li, Jiarui Ou
arxiv-2112-11444.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Tuo Sun, Wanrong Zheng, Shufan Yu, Mengxun Li, Jiarui Ou. 1
Introduction

A shares, also known as domestic shares, are shares that are denominated in Chinese currency Renminbi and traded in the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges, as well as the National Equities Exchange and Quotations. Financial analysts, as a dominant occupation of the Chinese financial services industry, write millions of research reports to pore over data to identify opportunities or evaluate outcomes for business decisions or investment recommendations.

arxiv-2210-14745.title: Identifying Counterfactual Queries with the R Package cfid
arxiv-2210-14745.creator: by Santtu Tikka
arxiv-2210-14745.description: Abstract In the framework of structural causal models, counterfactual queries describe events that concern multiple alternative states of the system under study. Counterfactual queries often take the form of “what if” type questions such as “would an applicant have been hired if they had over 10 years of experience, when in reality they only had 5 years of experience?

arxiv-2302-14666.title: Entanglement and Expansion
arxiv-2302-14666.creator: K. Boutivas, G. Pastras, and N. Tetradis
arxiv-2302-14666.description: Abstract We study the entanglement entropy resulting from tracing out local degrees of freedom of a quantum scalar field in an expanding universe. It is known that when field modes become superhorizon during inflation they evolve to increasingly squeezed states. We argue that this causes the entanglement entropy to grow continuously as successive modes cross the horizon.

arxiv-2403-05730.title: Emergent resonances in a thin film tailored by optically-induced small permittivity asymmetries
arxiv-2403-05730.creator: Rodrigo Berté, Thomas Possmayer, Andreas Tittl, Leonardo de S. Menezes, Stefan A. Maier
arxiv-2403-05730.description: Abstract I Abstract Resonances are usually associated with finite systems - the vibrations of clamped strings in a guitar or the optical modes in a cavity defined by mirrors. In optics, resonances may be induced in infinite continuous media via periodic modulations of their optical properties.

arxiv-2403-06861.title: Quantum thermodynamics of driven-dissipative condensates
arxiv-2403-06861.creator: Luísa Toledo Tude and Paul R. Eastham
arxiv-2403-06861.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Luísa Toledo Tude and Paul R. Eastham. Polariton condensates occur away from thermal equilibrium, in an open system where heat and particles are continually exchanged with reservoirs. These phenomena have been extensively analyzed in terms of kinetic equations. Based on the collection of knowledge about polariton kinetics provided by these simulations and by experimental works, we constructed a few-level model that captures the main processes involved in the buildup of a ground-state population of polaritons.

arxiv-2502-20915.title: The Feasibility Study of the GeV-Energy Muon Source Based on HIAF
arxiv-2502-20915.creator: Yu Xu, Xueheng Zhang, Yuhong Yu, Pei Yu, Li Deng, Jiajia Zhai, Liangwen Chen, He Zhao, Lina Sheng, Guodong Shen, Ziwen Pan, Qite Li, Chen Zhou, Qiang Li, Lei Yang, Zhiyu Sun
arxiv-2502-20915.description: Abstract Generating a mono-energetic, high-energy muon beam using accelerator facilities can be very attractive for many purposes, for example, improving muon tomography currently limited by the low flux and wide energy spread of cosmic ray muons, and searching for muon related new physics beyond the Standard Model.

arxiv-2503-14809.title: Learning with Expert Abstractions for Efficient Multi-Task Continuous Control
arxiv-2503-14809.creator: Jeff Jewett, Sandhya Saisubramanian
arxiv-2503-14809.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jeff Jewett, Sandhya Saisubramanian. Decision-making in complex, continuous multi-task environments is often hindered by the difficulty of obtaining accurate models for planning and the inefficiency of learning purely from trial and error. While precise environment dynamics may be hard to specify, human experts can often provide high-fidelity abstractions that capture the essential high-level structure of a task and user preferences in the target environment. Existing hierarchical approaches often target discrete settings and do not generalize across tasks.

arxiv-2505-19273.title: Eta-WavLM: Efficient Speaker Identity Removal in Self-Supervised Speech Representations Using a Simple Linear Equation
arxiv-2505-19273.creator: Giuseppe Ruggiero, Matteo Testa, Jurgen Van de Walle, Luigi Di Caro
arxiv-2505-19273.description: Abstract Self-supervised learning (SSL) has reduced the reliance on expensive labeling in speech technologies by learning meaningful representations from unannotated data. Since most SSL-based downstream tasks prioritize content information in speech, ideal representations should disentangle content from unwanted variations like speaker characteristics in the SSL representations.

pmc-10608224.title: The Difference in Paraspinal Muscle Parameters and the Correlation with Health-Related Quality of Life among Healthy Individuals, Patients with Degenerative Lumbar Scoliosis and Lumbar Spinal Stenosis
pmc-10608224.creator: Yinhao Liu, Lei Yuan, Yan Zeng, Jiajun Ni, Shi Yan, Yong Hai
pmc-10608224.description: (1) Background: Paraspinal muscle degeneration affects the quality of life in patients with degenerative lumbar scoliosis (DLS) and lumbar spinal stenosis (LSS). We aimed to describe the characteristics and differences in the paraspinal muscle parameters between patients with DLS and LSS and investigate their correlation with health-related quality of life (HRQOL).

pmc-10668705.title: Exploring Compassion towards Laboratory Animals in UK- and China-Based Undergraduate Biomedical Sciences Students
pmc-10668705.creator: Richard Fitzpatrick, Nicola Romanò, John Menzies
pmc-10668705.description: Simple SummaryResearch and teaching in biomedical sciences has led to huge advances in human wellbeing. However, some research activities require the use of non-human animals and can entail animal suffering. This suffering is obviously detrimental to the animal but can also negatively impact learners’ and researchers’ emotions or weaken the validity of the activity’s scientific outcomes.

pmc-11333710.title: Comparative study of axial displacement in digital and conventional implant prosthetic components
pmc-11333710.creator: Seungwon Back, Sunjai Kim, Jaehan Park, Se-Wook Pyo, Jae-Seung Chang
pmc-11333710.description: Axial displacement of prosthetic components is a major concern in implant dentistry, particularly during screw tightening. However, implant manufacturers provide different recommended torques for tightening implant prosthetic components, which can lead to errors in prosthesis fit before and after impression making. Implant–abutment connection angle or abutment geometries can affect axial displacement.

pmc-11503504.title: Assessment of Zygomaticomaxillary Suture Maturation in Patients With Unilateral Cleft Lip and Palate: Implications for Orthodontic Treatment Planning
pmc-11503504.creator: Niharika Bhatia, Navaneethan R
pmc-11503504.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionThe zygomaticomaxillary suture (ZMS) is vital for craniofacial development and orthodontic treatment planning. Located at the junction of the zygomatic and maxillary bones, the ZMS undergoes significant changes during growth, affecting midfacial morphology and stability.

pmc-11549133.title: Geschlechtersensible Gesundheitsindikatoren für die Gesundheitsberichterstattung am Robert Koch-Institut (GBE-GI) – Ein Pilotprojekt im Rahmen der „Joint Action PreventNCD“

pmc-11549133.description: Eine auf geschlechtersensiblen Indikatoren basierende Gesundheitsberichterstattung (GBE) kann Aufschluss über Geschlechterungleichheiten geben, die Gesundheitsförderung und Gesundheitsversorgung verbessern, Gender-Mainstreaming fördern sowie relevante Informationen für Gleichstellungsmaßnahmen zur Verfügung stellen. pmc-11725083.title: Trends of dental service utilization and expenditure in Taiwan from 2000 to 2020
pmc-11725083.creator: Ting-Chen Chen, Wen-Chi Liu, Shih-Jung Cheng, Shih-Pi Lin, Wender Lin
pmc-11725083.description: Background/purposeSince 1995, Taiwan's National Health Insurance (NHI) has offered a comprehensive dental coverage to over 99 % of the population. This study mainly analyzed the dental service utilization and expenditure trends by the gender, age, and service type and evaluated the resource allocation across different demographics from 2000 to 2020.

pmc-12700719.creator: Henrik Skov, Stefan Heinänen, Lars O. Mortensen, Johan Månsson, Lovisa Nilsson, Rune S. Tjørnløv, Ramunas Zydelis
pmc-12700719.description: With the planned large‐scale development of offshore wind farms, there is a need for an improved understanding of the potential future interactions between migrating common cranes ( Grus grus ) and the wind turbines as they cross areas of open sea during migration.

pmc-12932662.title: Bifidobacterium longum and prebiotic interventions restore early-life high-fat/high-sugar diet-induced alterations in feeding behavior in adult mice
pmc-12932662.creator: Cristina Cuesta-Marti, Eduardo Ponce-España, Friederike Uhlig, Iris Stoltenborg, Luiza A Wasiewska, Lamiah Kareem, Dara Hedayatpour, Loreto Olavarría-Ramírez, Cristina Rosell-Cardona, Thomaz F S Bastiaanssen, Gabriel S S Tofani, Benjamin Valderrama, Klara Vlckova, Suzanne L Dickson, Aonghus Lavelle,
pmc-12932662.description: An unhealthy diet disrupts feeding behavior and the gut microbiota, but whether early-life dietary effects persist, or can be restored later in life, remains unclear. We investigated whether microbiota-targeted interventions (FOS + GOS or Bifidobacterium longum APC1472) could restore early-life high-fat/high-sugar (HFHS) diet-induced feeding alterations in adult female and male mice.

pmc-13233665.title: A novel integrative multi-scale framework of inflammation and mechanical loading in knee osteoarthritis
pmc-13233665.creator: Juntong Lai, Damien Lacroix
pmc-13233665.description: Obesity is a well-known prominent risk factor for knee osteoarthritis (OA). The onset and development of knee OA are affected by multifactorial interplays, involving the degeneration of articular cartilage. Emerging evidence shows the negative effects of obesity on cartilage degeneration across multi-scales. Specifically, obesity can stimulate inflammation and alter the biomechanical responses of the joint.

uslaw-usc-t10-s8183.title: 10 U.S.C. § 8183 — State Department: assignment of enlisted members as custodians of buildings in foreign countries
uslaw-usc-t10-s8183.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s8183.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 823 (Special Assignments And Details). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Upon the request of the Secretary of State, the Secretary of the Navy may assign enlisted members of the naval service to serve as custodians under the supervision of the principal officer at any embassy, legation, or consulate.

uslaw-usc-t8-s1644.title: 8 U.S.C. § 1644 — Communication between State and local government agencies and Immigration and Naturalization Service
uslaw-usc-t8-s1644.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t8-s1644.description: United States Code, Title 8 (Aliens And Nationality); Chapter 14 (Restricting Welfare And Public Benefits For Aliens); Subchapter IV (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Notwithstanding any other provision of Federal, State, or local law, no State or local government entity may be prohibited, or in any way restricted, from sending to or receiving from the Immigration and Naturalization Service information.
